subject: WITHDRAWN - MPI-610 message was built on a WRONG card brief. Do NOT act on it.
body:
WITHDRAWN IN FULL. Ignore everything below the line - it is wrong and the work it described has been reverted off disk.

Fabio corrected the design 2026-08-23. MPI-610's brief said the Character Sheet moves OFF Krea 2 onto a Klein 4B/9B base-model selector. That is NOT the job. The real job is the TWO-SLOT shape Scribble to Object already ships - a Render model dropdown and a Blend model dropdown:

  slot 1  RENDER (generation)   krea2 / krea2-nsfw   -> Input_Base_Model (UNCHANGED, node #55)
  slot 2  BLEND  (head removal) klein-4b / klein-9b  -> Input_Edit_Model + Input_Edit_Clip

NO Krea 2 machinery is removed. The generation phase keeps its Krea 2 core, its
ClownsharKSampler ladder, Input_is_Turbo, Input_Negative and Input_Bypass_Filter_Lora.
The 4B/9B selector applies to the INPAINT phase, which is the one already on Klein.
Both phases get their own six LoRAs (Input_Lora_Phase1_* / Input_Lora_Phase2_*).

NOTHING IS OUTSTANDING FOR YOU. comfy_workflows/flow_character_sheet.json, its raw/ source and tests/inject-params-titles.test.cjs are all back at HEAD, and the suite is green. js/data/flowsRegistry.js and tests/flow-model-choice.test.cjs were never touched - you keep both, uncontested. The corrected design lives in .agents/mpi-kanban/tasks/MPI-610/brief.md.

One thing worth carrying into MPI-608 anyway: the Character Sheet wants per-phase racks on the SAME mechanism, so its Krea 2 phase needs Input_Lora_Phase1_1..6 and its Klein phase Input_Lora_Phase2_1..6.

--- original message follows, DO NOT ACT ON IT ---

MPI-610's GRAPH HALF IS DONE AND ON DISK, UNCOMMITTED. You hold the other half.

flow_character_sheet.json + its raw/ source are re-authored from Krea 2 onto Klein. I did
NOT touch js/data/flowsRegistry.js or tests/flow-model-choice.test.cjs - you hold both - so
the tree currently has 3 RED TESTS, all in flow-model-choice.test.cjs, all yours. Nothing is
committed: committing the graph alone puts master red, so the two halves must land together.

WHAT THE GRAPH NOW LOOKS LIKE

  Input_Edit_Model  UNETLoader  flux-2-klein-4b-int8-convrot.safetensors   (was Input_Base_Model)
  Input_Edit_Clip   CLIPLoader  qwen_3_4b.safetensors, type flux2         (was an untitled Load CLIP)

Same names flow_scribble_object's blend slot uses, so one convention covers every Klein slot.

THE FlowDef DIFF YOU NEED (js/data/flowsRegistry.js, id 'character-sheet'):

  requiredModels: [
      { label: 'Base model', models: ['klein-4b', 'klein-9b'] },
      'klein-4b',
  ],
  modelParams: {
      'klein-4b': {
          'Input_Edit_Model': 'flux-2-klein-4b-int8-convrot.safetensors',
          'Input_Edit_Clip.clip_name': 'qwen_3_4b.safetensors',
      },
      'klein-9b': {
          'Input_Edit_Model': 'flux-2-klein-9b-int8-convrot.safetensors',
          'Input_Edit_Clip.clip_name': 'qwen_3_8b_int8_convrot.safetensors',
      },
  },
  settingsModel: 'klein-4b',

Keep the second slot 'klein-4b' hard-required: the head-removal phase is 4B-pinned (below).
Input_Edit_Clip.clip_name MUST be the DOTTED key - clip_name is not on comfyController
_inject's spray list the way ckpt_name/unet_name are, so a plain key matches the node and
silently writes nothing.

TWO FIELDS MUST BE DELETED FROM `fields`, and this is not optional trim:

  * Input_is_Turbo - its node is GONE. Klein ships DISTILLED as ONE tier with no accelerator
    LoRA (docs/models/klein/README.md: "ONE tier, no accelerator LoRA"), so there is no
    second speed to select. The graph samples at a flat 4 steps, which is the MEASURED t2i
    number for this weight - 8 overcooks. Leaving the toggle declared ships a control that
    flips, saves, and changes nothing.
  * Input_Bypass_Filter_Lora - its node is GONE with the krea2 arms. It bypassed KREA 2's
    baked safety filter; Klein bakes no filter, so there is nothing to bypass.

Input_Negative also lost its node (Klein runs cfg 1.0, so the negative is bit-identical and
the graph zeroes it out of the positive). It was never a declared field - _buildParams emits
it unconditionally and a graph without the node skips it in silence, exactly as head-swap
already does. I already updated tests/inject-params-titles.test.cjs for that and for
Input_is_Turbo, and pinned input_edit_model + input_edit_clip there. That file is green.

WHAT I DELIBERATELY DID NOT CHANGE

  The head-removal branch (SAM3 -> crop -> Klein 4B + flux2-klein-4b-outpaint -> stitch,
  nodes 680-726) is untouched and still loads its OWN klein-4b UNETLoader/CLIPLoader. There
  is NO 9B outpaint LoRA - loraDeps.js says so explicitly and names this graph's node 708 as
  the LoRA's shipped second consumer - so that phase stays 4B whichever size the sheet is
  generated at. Do not repoint it at Input_Edit_Model: injecting klein-9b would take the
  outpaint LoRA with it and there is no 9B weight to bind.

  The `Input_Lora_1..6` rack is untouched and now hangs straight off Input_Edit_Model. When
  MPI-608's per-phase mechanism lands, this flow's Klein phase wants Input_Lora_Phase1_1..6
  the same way scribble-to-object got them. I did not add them - I only made sure nothing
  forbids them.

WHAT THE 3 RED TESTS WANT (tests/flow-model-choice.test.cjs, yours)

  1. 'every modelParams title EXISTS in the flow workflow' - passes once modelParams names
     Input_Edit_Model / Input_Edit_Clip.clip_name.
  2. 'the Character Sheet arms match the weights and the twin graph' (~line 244) - hardcodes
     Input_Base_Model + Input_Bypass_Filter_Lora + the krea2 twin graph krea2_t2i_nsfw.json.
     Rewrite against the two Klein arms; the scribble-object assertion in the same file
     (~line 405) is the shape to copy - it already checks a UNETLoader + a CLIPLoader whose
     clip_name is a widget not a link.
  3. 'the injector can actually WRITE both arms' (~line 324) - same two titles.

VERIFIED HERE, not asserted

  * Link graph: no dangling links, no duplicate ids, every input.link and output.links
    round-trips, every GetNode resolves to a SetNode. The only unconnected inputs are the
    15 optional ones that were already unconnected before the port.
  * Every class_type exists on the live engine's /object_info, every REQUIRED input is
    present, every link resolves to a real output slot, and no node is orphaned.
  * node scripts/validate-injection-rules.mjs: clean.
  * Full suite 722/725 - the 3 above and nothing else.

NOT DONE, and it is Fabio's call, not mine: nobody has compared a Klein sheet against a
Krea 2 sheet. Krea 2 was chosen for a reason and the card says his eye on real sheets is
what closes this.

recent_events.summary: Withdrawn by its own sender. The message restated MPI-610's card brief, and Fabio confirmed the brief is wrong: the Character Sheet gains a SECOND model slot on the inpaint phase, it does not move its generation phase off Krea 2. Every file it described was reverted to HEAD before this was written; nothing is pending on the recipient.
